brand.name: Proa
auth.signin.title: Sign in to your space
auth.signin.sub: Every athlete's week, in one place.
auth.signup.title: Create your space
auth.signup.sub: Start free. You'll invite your athletes in the next step.
auth.checkEmail: We sent you an email to confirm your account. Open it and come back here.
auth.resetSent: If that email exists, you'll get a link to change your password.
auth.athleteNote: Are you an athlete? Your coach will send you an email invitation.
auth.err.credentials: That email and password don't match.
auth.err.unconfirmed: You haven't confirmed your email yet. Check your inbox.
auth.err.exists: There's already an account with that email. Try signing in.
auth.err.password: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.err.rate: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a minute.
onb.title: Set up your space
onb.sub: Three details and you're in. You can change all of it later.
onb.name: What's your space called?
onb.nameHint: Your name, or your brand's. It's what your athletes will see.
onb.sportHint: You can still have athletes from other sports.
onb.timezoneHint: We use it to work out your athletes' schedules.
onb.accentHint: It paints the buttons and the menu, and it's what your athlete will see. Gym, field and match colours don't change: they're the same for everyone.
onb.seatsHint: Paused or archived athletes don't take a seat.
onb.err.name: Give your space a name.
home.title: Home
home.empty.title: You don't have any athletes yet
home.empty.body: Add your first athlete and then build their week. They'll get an invitation to sign in with their own account.
home.soon.title: On the way
home.soon.body: The athlete profile, the intake questionnaire and the weekly calendar arrive in the next stages.
ath.title: My athletes
ath.sub: Each active athlete takes a seat. Paused and archived ones don't.
ath.seatsFull: You've reached {limit} active athletes. Pause one to add another.
ath.clubHint: If they train with a team, those hours go in the intake questionnaire later.
ath.th.name: Athlete
ath.empty.title: No athletes yet
ath.empty.body: Add the first one and then fill in their intake: that's where their week comes from.
ath.emptyFilter.title: Nobody here
ath.emptyFilter.body: No athletes in this state. Try another tab.
ath.err.firstName: Enter at least the first name.
ath.err.seats: You've hit your plan's active athlete limit.
ath.invite.title: Invite the athlete
ath.invite.hint: Send it however you normally talk to them. It works once and expires in 30 days. Generating a new one kills the old link.
inv.heroTitle: Everything you have to do, in one place
inv.what1: You see your whole week: gym, field, meals and recovery.
inv.what2: You tick off what you did and how you felt.
inv.what3: You ask your coach about a specific exercise.
inv.from: {ws} invited you to Proa. Create your account and you'll see your week.
inv.signOutFirst: Sign out of this account and open the link again
inv.notFound.title: Invalid link
inv.notFound.body: This link doesn't exist. Ask your coach to send you a new one.
inv.expired.title: Link expired
inv.expired.body: This link has expired. Ask your coach to send you a new one.
inv.used.title: Already used
inv.used.body: This invitation has already been used. Sign in with your email and password.
inv.coach.title: This is a coach account
inv.coach.body: A coach account can't become an athlete: you'd lose access to your space.
inv.error.title: Something went wrong
inv.error.body: We couldn't open your invitation. Try again in a bit.
in.title: Intake
in.sub: Everything the athlete tells you. The hours below are what builds their week later.
in.sessions: Sessions a week they can do
in.goalsPh: What they want to achieve and by when.
in.injuriesPh: What, when and how they recovered.
in.weekNote: Study, work and training with their club. What's left blank is where load can actually go: this is where the plan comes from.
in.slot.title: Busy slot
in.slot.label: Label
in.slot.errOrder: The end time has to be after the start time.
ap.free: They have {hours} h free in the week, between 06:00 and 24:00.
ap.noWeek: You haven't entered their fixed hours yet.
aw.soon.title: Your week is coming
aw.soon.body: Your coach is building your plan. Once it's published you'll see it here: gym, field, meals and recovery, day by day.
aw.ready.title: Your account is ready
aw.ready.body: You can sign in with your email and password from any phone. Save this page to your home screen to keep it handy.
set.title: Your space
set.sub: How your athletes see you and how their schedules are worked out.
set.planNote: While Proa is being built, every space has the same limit. Paid tiers come later.
